word-video-game.t: This {video game} is very popular with kids.
I bought a new {video game} yesterday.

word-gamer.t: She became a {gamer} at the age of ten.

word-game-console.t: I connected the {game console} to the TV.
Is this {game console} still on sale?

word-controller.t: Give me the {controller}, it's my turn.
This {controller} has two sticks and many buttons.

word-headset.t: I wear a {headset} when I play online.
Her {headset} has a very good microphone.
Can you hear me through the {headset}?

word-load-game.t: Do you want to {load} your saved game?
I will {load} the last save and try again.
How do I {load} an old save file?

word-checkpoint.t: The game saves automatically at each {checkpoint}.
Run to the next {checkpoint} before the timer ends.

word-quest.t: The old man gave me a new {quest}.
She finished the {quest} and got a sword.
This {quest} is too hard for my level.

word-mission.t: Your {mission} is to find the key.

word-boss-game.t: The {boss} is much stronger than I expected.
Save your potions for the {boss} fight.

word-game-character.t: My favorite {character} is a brave knight.

word-avatar.t: Choose a name and an {avatar} for your account.

word-multiplayer.t: This game has a great {multiplayer} mode.
The {multiplayer} is more fun than the story.

word-single-player.t: I prefer {single-player} games when I'm tired.
The {single-player} story takes about ten hours.

word-server.t: Too many people are on this {server}.

word-lag.t: The {lag} made me lose the match.
Is the {lag} caused by your internet?

word-patch.t: A new {patch} came out this morning.
You need to download the {patch} before you play.

word-bug.t: I found a {bug} in the new level.

word-glitch.t: A strange {glitch} let me walk through walls.
There was a {glitch} in the sound.
The screen showed a {glitch} for a second.

word-achievement.t: Finishing the game without dying is a hard {achievement}.

word-high-score.t: My {high score} is twelve thousand points.
She beat the {high score} by a lot.

word-leaderboard.t: Check the {leaderboard} to see your rank.
His name is at the top of the {leaderboard}.

word-inventory.t: Open your {inventory} and choose a potion.
You can't carry more; clean up your {inventory}.

word-item.t: You can find a rare {item} in this cave.
Use this {item} to open the door.

word-armor.t: Put on your {armor} before the fight.
I bought new {armor} for my knight.

word-health-points.t: I only have ten {health points} left.
Eating food gives you more {health points}.
The enemy lost all its {health points}.

word-experience-points.t: You get {experience points} for each enemy.
I need a hundred more {experience points}.
Quests give you a lot of {experience points}.

word-level-up.t: You {level up} when you get enough points.

word-open-world.t: This {open world} is huge, and you can go anywhere.
I like {open world} games because I can go anywhere.
The {open world} has mountains, forests and cities.

word-npc.t: The {NPC} in the village sells swords.
Talk to every {NPC} to get hints.
That {NPC} walks around the market all day.

word-tutorial.t: I skipped the {tutorial} and got lost.

word-difficulty.t: The {difficulty} is too high for me.
He raised the {difficulty} to make it exciting.

phrase-game-over.t: {Game over}! Do you want to try again?
The screen said {game over} after my last life.
It's {game over} if you fall into the water.

word-pause.t: Press this button to {pause} the game.
Can you {pause}? I need to answer the phone.

word-restart.t: I want to {restart} from the beginning.
The computer will {restart} after the update.

word-settings.t: Open the {settings} and turn down the music.
Check your {settings} if the picture looks bad.
I changed the {settings} to make it easier.

word-graphics.t: The {graphics} in this game are beautiful.
My old computer can't run such good {graphics}.
I lowered the {graphics} to improve speed.

word-sequel.t: I liked the first one more than the {sequel}.
Is there a {sequel} to this game?

word-shooter-game.t: He plays a {shooter game} every night.
This {shooter game} has a lot of weapons.

word-strategy-game.t: A {strategy game} takes a lot of thinking.
I built a city in a {strategy game}.

word-role-playing-game.t: In this {role-playing game} you create your own hero.
She plays a {role-playing game} with her friends.
My favorite {role-playing game} has a long story.

word-racing-game.t: I play a {racing game} with my cousin.
This {racing game} has fast cars and real roads.

word-simulator.t: This {simulator} lets you fly a real plane.

word-esports.t: {Esports} has millions of fans around the world.
The {esports} final was on TV last night.

word-stream-v.t: Do you want to {stream} the tournament?

word-teammate.t: Listen to your {teammates} during the match.

word-voice-chat.t: We use {voice chat} to make a plan.
There's too much noise on {voice chat}.

word-noob.t: Don't be mean to him; he's a {noob}.
I was a {noob} when I started.

phrase-good-game.t: We lost, but I still said {good game}.

word-joystick.t: He plays flying games with a {joystick}.

word-aim.t: You must {aim} at the red target.

word-defend.t: Your team needs to {defend} the base.
She learned to {defend} against fast attacks.

word-craft.t: You can {craft} a sword from iron.
It takes ten minutes to {craft} a boat.

word-explore.t: I love to {explore} new places in games.

word-unlock.t: You can {unlock} new levels by winning.

word-cooperative.t: This is a {cooperative} game for four friends.
{Cooperative} play is more fun with a good team.
We prefer {cooperative} modes to fighting each other.

word-damage-n.t: The dragon does a lot of {damage}.

word-critical-hit.t: You get a {critical hit} by luck.

word-cooldown.t: The {cooldown} on this power is ten seconds.
A short {cooldown} makes the spell very strong.

word-ping.t: A low {ping} gives you a better match.
